sources.quote: Beta Serpentis, Latinized from β Serpentis, also named Zhou, is a binary star system in the constellation Serpens, in its head.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 60 times the Sun's luminosity at 8,399 K, so 3.651 solar radii.
